title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show captured on a pristine Miller soundboard recording with smoking performances of All Over Now, Shakedown and an unexpected Throwing Stones > Day Job pairing
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this Miller‑sourced soundboard tape sounds awesome and captures a ripping performance – the band is on fire from Shakedown to a monster All Over Now, and the setlist even throws in a surprising Throwing Stones > Day Job transition. The recording is clear and balanced, making the show easy to enjoy.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the musical energy and the crystal‑clear soundboard source; a third comment is neutral about setlist, so overall rating is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as "awesome" and a "Miller gem," indicating crisp, clear mix with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic set with strong transitions; highlighted by the unusual Throwing Stones into Day Job pairing that fans found exciting.
